Class GTNetIdempotencyService

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.gtnet.GTNetIdempotencyService
@Service public class GTNetIdempotencyService extends Object
Recognizes a message that has already been delivered and answers it from what the first delivery produced.

Redelivery is a normal event rather than an attack: both delivery tasks re-send the same persisted GTNetMessage, and the envelope carries its id unchanged, so a retry after a lost response is byte-identical. Without this the second delivery would insert a second row, repeat the handler's side effects and charge the peer's daily budget again.

The identity is the peer-scoped triple (id_gt_net, send_recv, id_source_gt_net_message), backed by the unique key uk_gt_net_message_source. The sender-local id alone is not an identity: it is only unique within the sending instance.

The first handshake is outside this mechanism. It has no peer row and no stored message until it is accepted, so there is nothing to key on; a repeat is refused deterministically by the handler's own HANDSHAKE_ALREADY_ESTABLISHED, which is its idempotency.

    • replayOutcome

      public MessageEnvelope replayOutcome(GTNet myGTNet, GTNetMessage previousRow, byte originalCode)
      Rebuilds the answer the peer was given the first time.

      A request that was answered has its answer stored with reply_to pointing at the request row, so the answer is reproduced from that row — parameters included, which is what makes a repeated token refresh return the same token pair. A request that is still awaiting an administrator gets the same deferred acknowledgement it got the first time, and an announcement gets an acknowledgement carrying DUPLICATE_DELIVERY, so the sender can tell a recognized repeat apart from a fresh receipt.

      What cannot be reproduced is the optional JSON payload of the original answer: gt_net_message stores no payload. That is why a handler whose answer carries one declares itself a side-effect-free query and is run again instead of replayed.

      Parameters:
      myGTNet - the local GTNet entry
      previousRow - the row the first delivery created
      originalCode - the message code of the delivery being repeated
      Returns:
      the envelope to answer the repeat with
